meta.title: vLLM benchmark setup — Qwen2.5-7B on one L4 GPU

views.label: Request path
views.note: The client Job's requests reach vLLM through a ClusterIP Service; vLLM batches them onto the L4 GPU.

views.label: Concurrency scaling
views.note: Latency stays flat from concurrency 1 to 16 while throughput scales near-linearly; KV cache stays under 3%.

boundaries.label: bench-gpu namespace on fsi-demo-cluster (namespace deleted after the run)
bench-gpu NodePool — dedicated, deleted after the run

cards.title: Measured throughput scaling
items: Concurrency 16: 208 tokens/s aggregate (client), up to 243 tokens/s peak (server)

cards.title: Measured latency (full ~100-128 token response)
items: Concurrency 16: p50 7.52 s, p90 8.74 s — latency barely grows despite 16x the load

cards.title: Bandwidth, not compute, is the limit
items: GPU KV cache usage: 0.1% (c=1) to 2.6% (c=16) — never the constraint
Batch-1 decode: ~15.2GB bf16 weights per token via ~300GB/s GDDR6 caps it near the measured 17-18 tok/s
Compute: ~3 TFLOP/s at peak vs L4's ~121 TFLOPS bf16 — a few percent of ceiling
